chunks: Allah sent him at a time when there had been no prophets for some time, and the peoples had been in slumber for a long time, and the twist of the rope had loosened, so he came to them with confirmation of what was before it, and with the light to be followed.
That is the Quran, so ask it to speak, and it will not speak; but I will inform you about it:
Know that it contains knowledge of what is to come, stories of the past, cure for your ills, and regulation for whatever faces you.

key_terms.الْمُبْرَمِ: The tightly twisted rope, symbolizing the cohesion of the covenant or community
key_terms.فَتْرَة: Period of absence or delay, specifically referring to the gap between prophets
key_terms.هَجْعَة: Slumber or deep sleep, metaphorically used for spiritual neglect

ai.seo_question: What are the four main functions of the Quran described in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali contextualizes the Prophet's arrival during *fatrat al-rusul* (the interval of prophets) as a divine response to spiritual stagnation, positioning the Quran not merely as a silent text but as an active repository of eschatological and historical knowledge. This passage underscores the Shia hermeneutical view of the Quran as *dawa'* (cure) and *nizam* (order), reflecting its role in structuring both individual piety and communal governance.
